name: Curiosity Question Cartoon
description: A bright, simple cartoon moment with one main subject, one revealing contrast, and a short model-rendered curiosity hook instead of the full YouTube title.

recipe.headlineGuidance: Write one truthful 1–4 word hook that creates a concrete question or surprise. It must describe the episode's real subject or tension, never use empty bait such as 'YOU WON'T BELIEVE', and never make a claim the episode cannot support.
recipe.conceptGuidance: Build one instantly readable cartoon situation: a single oversized subject or creature, optionally paired with one reacting guide or one revealing representative object. The frame should feel like the visual answer is almost in reach.
compositionRules: Reserve the full upper quarter for one short, large curiosity hook; render the exact generated hook in hand-lettered uppercase yellow text with a thick uneven black outline.
Use one dominant main subject in the lower three quarters. A second reacting character or representative reveal object is optional, but do not create a crowded ensemble.
Make the contrast or tension visible without a written explanation: scale, expression, one object, or one simple action should carry the click.
Use a simplified setting with only enough location cues to make the situation immediately legible at phone size.
Keep the full YouTube episode title out of the artwork; the hook and the title must be truthful partners, not duplicate sentences.
requiredElements: one oversized primary subject or creature
one emotionally clear reveal, contrast, or reaction
avoid: the full episode title, explanatory paragraphs, labels, callouts, or a dense infographic
more than two competing main subjects
generic bait, false danger, fabricated facts, copied characters, logos, or channel trade dress
small illegible lettering, placeholder text, random letters, or a text overlay added after rendering
recipe.visualStyleGuidance: Original 2D waxy-outline cartoon: thick slightly wobbly black crayon-marker contours, flat saturated blocks of sky blue, leaf green, warm orange, yellow, and red accent, oversized expressive eyes, simple rounded objects, minimal shading, and a deliberately hand-drawn texture. The project visual art style remains the final rendering authority.
